b15l_counterfactual.censoring_statement: conditioned on B15O's frozen 5,000 launches, which descend from B15i's own observations and from no closed recorder; a cell is absent when its B15i entry checkpoint is missing, when its B15N exit checkpoint is missing or withheld pending chain confirmation, or when its launch transaction published no fee basis points at t0 and therefore has no admissible fee schedule

inherited_censoring_statement_superseded.statement: conditioned on cells where BOTH an entry and an exit account checkpoint exist; B15f schedules from B15a, which B15k measured holding 29% of the launches B15i observes, so this population is censored by the recorders and not by the market
inherited_censoring_statement_superseded.why: it names B15f scheduling from B15a; the B15Q population descends from neither

b15l_counterfactual.label: COUNTERFACTUAL_UNREACTING_BOOK

h_10000_slots|1.cap_hit_note: a cap-hit capacity is at least the ceiling and was not measured further; it is never reported as equal to it
h_10000_slots|1.circular_liquidity_dependence_note: the exit was payable only out of reserves our own purchase had added; an exit funded by one's own entry is not liquidity
h_10000_slots|1.circular_liquidity_dependence_vacuous: the frozen condition requires an external capacity of exactly zero, and no cell in any group reached it: every book supported at least a few lamports. The condition is reported as measured, at zero, and the quantity below was added afterwards to measure what it was reaching for
h_10000_slots|1.curve_resolution_floor_note: the smallest input acquiring at least one token. The pinned exact-input formula carries (q - 1) in its numerator, so a one-lamport buy acquires nothing at any reserves. This is the curve's resolution, not a liquidity limit, and the capacity search runs above it because the admissible set is otherwise not a prefix
h_10000_slots|1.label: LIQUIDITY_CAPACITY_DIAGNOSTIC
h_10000_slots|1.self_funded_shortfall_note: cells where B15L could price the exit but the EXTERNAL book could not support the full frozen position, and by how many lamports it fell short. Defined after seeing the frozen circular condition return zero, and labelled so that is visible rather than buried
